summary: Frontend-only regression test for 'Cannot read property ErrorBoundary of undefined' render crash. All 7 requested flows verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844). The route module load crash is FIXED — /paycheck/[id] loads cleanly, the Set savings bottom sheet (which imports/uses SavingsRec) opens without error, and the tracker route (which had the CALENDAR trigger bug) renders with streak card + YTD bento + year/month chips + goals section. Dashboard renders year chips (2026-2028) + 12 month chips + buffer hero + YTD bento. Goals screen (/goals) loads with empty state. Bills tab renders without crash. No pageerror or console error captured during navigation across tabs.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-notifications throws on Android in Expo Go: 'Android Push notifications functionality provided by expo-notifications was removed from Expo Go with the release of SDK 53. Use a development build instead.' Not blocking web, but will crash Android Expo Go preview when tracker mounts. Reference: /app/frontend/src/notifications.ts:1 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/tracker.tsx:19. Consider guarding with Platform.OS !== 'android' || !Constants.appOwnership==='expo', or moving to a dev build.

action_items: No action needed on the reported bug — regression fix is verified working.

Optional: guard expo-notifications imports/scheduling on Android Expo Go (SDK 53+ removed remote notifications). Currently only a warning on web, but blocks Android Expo Go bundling for tracker route.

Optional cleanup: metro logs also show 'Route ./(tabs)/tracker.tsx is missing the required default export' and same for ./bill/[id].tsx — these appear during Android bundling only (web bundles fine and screens render). Likely a stale HMR/cache artifact, but worth confirming both files have default exports (they do on disk).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression for the ErrorBoundary crash is closed. Default active month on Dashboard/Tracker is 2027-01 which has no paychecks; testing paycheck-detail requires switching to 2026 first (year-chip-2026 → month with data like 2026-09). Paycheck cards use testID='paycheck-card-<id>', savings modal uses testID='savings-sheet' + 'input-savings-amount', tracker uses testID='tracker-screen' + 'streak-card', goals opens via testID='open-goals'.
rca_of_issue: Original crash: Babel/Metro could not bundle /app/frontend/app/paycheck/[id].tsx because of an inline type reference `rec: import('@/src/api').SavingsRec` inside a function parameter — TypeScript inline import types trip the react-native Babel preset for route modules and export the module as undefined, causing expo-router/useScreens.js:141 to read `.ErrorBoundary` on undefined. Second contributor: `Notifications.SchedulableTriggerInputTypes.CALENDAR` with day/hour/minute keys is invalid — CALENDAR expects seconds/UTC fields; only MONTHLY takes day/hour/minute. Both fixes applied by main agent (hoisted `import { SavingsRec }` at top of paycheck/[id].tsx and switched trigger to MONTHLY in tracker.tsx). Verified: route module now loads, paycheck detail renders, savings sheet opens, tracker no longer throws on schedule call (web platform path returns early anyway).
